# flashblade_resiliency_group (Data Source)

Reads an existing FlashBlade resiliency group by name. Resiliency groups are hardware-managed high-availability groupings reported by the array (API 2.23+).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "flashblade_resiliency_group" "example" {
  name = "rg0"
}

output "resiliency_group_status" {
  value = data.flashblade_resiliency_group.example.status
}

output "resiliency_group_status_details" {
  value = data.flashblade_resiliency_group.example.status_details
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the resiliency group to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The non-modifiable globally unique identifier of the resiliency group.
- `status` (String) Status of the resiliency group. One of `critical`, `healthy`, `unhealthy`.
- `status_details` (String) Human-readable description of the status when the group is not healthy. Empty when healthy.
